title: Studio: the landing card of each installed base says "n customized, m switched off", read from the per-package customization read
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P2, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P2 "N-24 landing counts"; Q8 makes it one of the two conditions for retiring Setup › Packaged automation (N-28). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28411

Part of #28236 (P2, child **N-24**) · governs: ADR-0146 D3 ("Upgrade and audit": one line per package, "n customized, m switched off"), D4 / Q8 (Packaged automation retires after the ledger switch and this card) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: S.

**Why it waits.** The numbers are the server's: N-15 (#28411) serves, per base, the overrides, extensions and switched-off items with their counts. This card draws them and computes none.

**Business reason.** Before an upgrade, or just to check, an administrator wants to see at a glance which installed apps they have changed and what they have switched off. Studio's landing should say it on each app's card ("HotCRM — 4 customized, 2 switched off"). Today the only deployment-wide view is Setup's Packaged automation page, which covers flows and actions only.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- Studio's landing is `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`. Read-only packages get one card each (:369–402): name, id, a "read-only" chip, and a link out to Setup (`studio-landing-overlay`, :389). No card carries a count.
- Package rows come from `fetchPackages()` (`packages-io.ts`), with `writable` as the server's verdict.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts`: `isCustomizationPackage` (:119) and `customizationBasePackageId` (:111) recognize a pair id.
- N-15's route and response field names: not landed, not verified.

**Wanted.**
1. Each read-only base card carries one line: "n customized, m switched off" (zh 「已定制 n 项，已停用 m 项」). The numbers are N-15's served counts for that base, as served. n covers overrides and extensions, as N-15 counts them.
2. Zero is shown as zero only when N-15 answered. While loading, the line shows no number. On a failed read it shows a muted "couldn't read customizations", with the server's sentence in the title, never "0".
3. When the base has a pair, the line links to it in Studio (the pair's Studio URL, `/studio/hotcrm.custom/data` for HotCRM; N-19 later folds this into the base). The switched-off part links to the base's Automations pillar, where N-04's switch lives.
4. No line on a writable package or on a pair (`isCustomizationPackage`). A pair id is never sent to N-15, which refuses it.
5. One read per read-only base, capped by the cards drawn, or one batched read if N-15 offers one. The landing renders before the counts arrive.

**Tests.** Stubbed N-15 answers:
- a base with 3 overrides, 1 extension and 2 switched off reads "4 customized, 2 switched off" and links to `<base>.custom`;
- a base with no pair reads "0 customized, 0 switched off" with no pair link;
- a failed read shows no number;
- a writable package and a pair draw no line and send no request;
- the landing paints before the counts resolve.

**Release safety.** Safe on its own: read-only drawing of a served read (`Blocked-by: #28411`). Packaged automation is not touched here. Its retirement is N-28.

**Not here.** The read itself (N-15). Rail marks and the "only customizations" filter (N-19). Retiring Packaged automation and the landing's Setup link (N-28). Directory marks (N-26b).

**Dedupe.** Searched `studio landing customized switched off`, `landing counts customization`: only #28411 (the read) and closed history.

Links back: #28236, #28411, ADR-0146 D3, D4, Q8.
